_comment: Code-switch glossary: English/loan terms that should render consistently in Latin script every time they appear in a corrected Urdu transcript. Key = the form to look for, value = the canonical Latin-script form. See src/correction/glossary.py.
_finding_2026_09_09: Left empty on purpose after surveying the large-v3 re-transcription of all 373 podcast clips. Whisper large-v3 already applies the intended convention natively -- it writes Urdu in Urdu script and English in Latin script (e.g. 'دونوں کے جو biology وہ same ہے'), with 1208 distinct Latin-script words already present. Only ~22 occurrences corpus-wide were English terms still in Urdu script, and most of those are naturalized loanwords that standard written Urdu renders in Urdu script anyway (سائنس, یونیورسٹی, ٹیکنالوجی), or correct usage that a blanket replace would damage ('اردو میڈیم' -> 'اردو Medium'). Adding entries would risk more harm than benefit at that volume. Populate this if a future corpus shows systematic mis-transliteration.
